node: Broadline distributors and contracted restaurant procurement
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around restaurant broadline distribution and contracted procurement. The key mapping is two-sided: large foodservice distributors are the obvious chokepoint references, while underfollowed restaurant operators or specialty distributors may carry hidden margin exposure or niche distribution power. Best-supported discovery leads from the provided/search evidence are GENK, where filings disclose high Sysco dependence, and HFFG, a micro-cap specialty distributor to Asian restaurants. PFGC is included as a large-cap but still relevant non-mega reference/competitor because its Foodservice segment directly serves independent and chain restaurants. No buy/sell view is implied.
